summary: Cache provider reads and rate-limit cooldowns in Planfile sync

delivery.outcome: Planfile provider reads use shared SQLite TTL caching, cross-process request coalescing and cooldowns, while mutations invalidate cached reads.
nonGoals: No GitLab or Jira SDK transport interception.
No provider data mutations during tests.

architecture.decision: Wrap read-only provider transport calls with procache; preserve explicit mutation paths and clear provider read namespaces after writes.
architecture.rollback: Revert the provider cache integration commits; provider reads return to direct transport calls.

commands: python -m pytest -p no:wellmanifest_governance -q tests/test_github_deduplication.py tests/test_github_sync_preserves_issue.py tests/test_sync_routing.py tests/test_github_projects.py tests/test_onedev_backend.py tests/test_generic_cache.py
